ada-handle.note: Kora Labs handlecontract scripts from official api.handle.me/scripts: decentralized minting (demimnt/demimntmpt/demimntprx/demiord), personalization (pers1-5, persprx/perspz/persdsg/perslfc), subhandles; plus 2023 Personalization 6c043fc9 (CRFA/Eternl). Excluded hal*/mkpl contracts also registered there. $handle policy f0ff48bb (legacy_policy_id in koralabs/decentralized-minting deploy/mainnet yaml) is a native script: not in transaction_scripts; assets table shows 42 mint tx in Sept 2026 (~150k all-time). sept2026Tx is Plutus-script-based only.

agora.note: LiqwidDAO's mainnet Agora deployment, listed under Liqwid Finance in the CRFA and Eternl registries as 'Agora validators governor/proposal/freeMultisig' plus the Agora Stake/Proposal/MultiSig/Governor token mint policies. This is the Liqwid instance, so it overlaps with Liqwid's own identifiers if those are tracked separately. Other Agora users (e.g. Clarity) are parameterised separately and not included. NOTE: these 7 hashes are also part of the liqwid entry.

andamio.note: Andamio Protocol V2 mainnet global contracts from the official contract-verification page (also mainnet-v2/params.yaml). Policies: Access Token, Instance, Instance Admin, Instance Provider, Index Admin, Index Ref Token. Spend-validator payment hashes: Global State ebcf819e, Index Ref 03a30e09, Instance Governance 6415f31b. Index/Instance/Instance-Provider scripts share hashes with their policies. Per-project treasuries and per-course/project instance scripts are parameterized and not listed, so this undercounts. Active 2025-02-21 to 2026-07-20, 0 in Sept 2026.

asteria.note: Mainnet Challenge validators: Asteria (addr1w824...), Pellet (spend + FUEL mint policy) and Spacetime (spend + ship mint policy). Addresses are cross-checked in frontend/src/stores/challenge.ts. Activity runs from 2025-08-06 to 2026-06-11, so 0 in Sept 2026 (the challenge appears finished).

atala-trace.note: IOHK/BeefChain partnership using Atala TRACE announced at the Cardano Virtual Summit, July 2020. This is an announcement date, not a documented go-live. No end date or on-chain identifiers documented.

book-io.note: Book.io Plutus time-lock / swap / archive validators (CRFA + Eternl; last used Feb 2025). Book.io's main activity is minting DEAs under 893 native collection policies listed by the official API https://api.book.io/api/v0/collections (saved to scratchpad bookio_policies.json); those are native scripts not in transaction_scripts; assets table shows 38 mint/burn tx in Sept 2026 across them.

cardano-ballot.note: Vote-commitment (Merkle root) metadata label: l1.transaction.metadata.label=${VOTING_METADATA_LABEL:11113}, also Helm default 11113. On-chain bodies confirmed (e.g. type COMMITMENTS, CARDANO_SUMMIT_AWARDS_2025). Activity is event-driven (Sep-Dec 2023, Sep-Oct 2024, Jun-Jul 2025, Sep-Oct 2025); none since Nov 2025, so 0 in Sept 2026.

cardano-card.note: Custodial Visa card in the Wirex app; no on-chain identifiers. EMURGO-Wirex partnership/launch announced Nov 2025 (Cardano Summit Berlin); service ends 31 Oct 2026.

cardano-wall.note: Label 309 = CIP-0190 Proof-of-Existence record (CIP-10 registry), the standard Cardano Wall publishes with its SDKs and gateway. Caveat: 23 older label-309 tx (2021-2023, e.g. groux.art claims, a pool message) are unrelated. CIP-0190-format records start 2026-06-18 (10 tx to 2026-10-14). Label 309 is an open standard, so third-party gateways may also write it.

charli3.note: Push-oracle feed validators and feed-NFT policies documented on the Charli3 mainnet networks page, plus older feed scripts from Yaci Store dApp registry, CRFA and Eternl. All documented feed validators stop updating in early June 2026 (last tx 2026-06-05); no mainnet addresses for the newer ODV pull oracle are published, so Sept 2026 = 0.

cip113-programmable-tokens.note: Mainnet protocol bootstrap (tx bfefbd22..., 2026-10-02): programmable_logic_base, programmable_logic_global, transfer, third_party, unfracking, issuance_logic, registry, protocol-params NFT policy, registry issuance policy and upgrade_multisig. Per-token issuance_mint policies are per-token and not included. Deployed 2026-10-02 (10 tx through 2026-10-19), so 0 in Sept 2026 is expected.

commitproof.note: The site's wallet flow calls attachMetadata({label:8413n}) with {hash, algo, version, app, ts}. All 33 label-8413 tx on chain (2026-03-01 to 2026-09-20) carry app="commitproof.com". The card-payment path is server-side and its label is unconfirmed, but no other 8413 traffic exists.

danogo.note: Dano Finance contracts from StricaHQ registry (CLMM pool, flexible/fixed/leverage lending pools+loans+params, oracle v1/v2, staking, BTC-grow, bond/borrow validators) plus Eternl-registry CLMM config/param/ref-holder scripts and 2023 bond swap validators (CRFA DanogoBond, address-checked). CLMM pool hash d8b69fc5 confirmed by official dano-finance/clmm-sdk constants.ts (POOL_SCRIPT_HASH_MAINNET). Excluded 1d2390ba "OptimBond Validator" (also registered to Optim Finance). Sept is dominated by the CLMM pool (~35k tx).

dexhunter.note: Stop Loss validator (StricaHQ, TxPipe audit; inactive since 2024-08) and DCA Execute validator (CRFA + Eternl registries, address-verified). Aggregated swaps run through the routed DEXes' own contracts and are not counted here.

djed.note: Current Djed contracts (order, pool, treasury validators; live since 2024-12-16) from the Open DJED mainnet registry, plus the original 2023-01 to 2024-08 Djed contracts from Yaci Store dApp registry, CRFA and Eternl. Djed oracle validators (old 8c6a7307..., new 89829415...) and oracle-NFT policy are deliberately excluded because their transactions are price-feed updates, not usage (the new oracle alone has ~3.5k tx/month). No Djed activity between 2024-08-08 and 2024-12-16 (contract migration).

echoforge.note: EchoCert mainnet minting policy (documint validator parameterized with EchoForge's treasury and issuer key 2fbe7f57...), documented with on-chain assets in mainnet-assets.json. The validator is per-issuer-parameterized, so certificates from other issuer keys use other policy IDs and are not covered. 3 mint tx 2026-04-11 to 2026-06-07.

fluidtokens.note: Lending v1-v3 scripts from Eternl registry (projectId fluid-tokens; v1 address also in FluidTokens DefiLlama adapter), Aquarium parameters/staker/tank from FluidTokens ft-aquarium-node ContractDerivationTest (mainnet), and Lending v4 hashes + config NFT policies from the live mainnet ConfigDatum/LMConfigDatum captures in ft-aquarium-node src/test/resources/loans-v4 (deployments 2026-09-11..2026-10-01). Excluded smart-tokens (CIP-113) spend hash and one unidentified datum field. 16 listed hashes have no tx yet.

hyperledger-identus.note: Label 21325 = PRISM Verifiable Data Registry for did:prism (CIP-10). The NeoPRISM indexer filters and the submitter writes this label, and the Identus SDK docs use setMetadata(21325, ...). 6833 tx 2022-09-13 to 2026-08-29. Last tx 2026-08-29 and 0 in Sept 2026. Activity is low and bursty in 2026 (1 tx each in Jul and Aug).

iagon.note: Iagon staking/storage-payment scripts from StricaHQ, Yaci Store dApp registry, CRFA and Eternl registries.

indigo.note: Indigo v1 (2022-11), v2 (2024-04) and v3 (2026-05-28) CDP, stability pool, staking, governance and iAsset scripts from StricaHQ registry, Yaci Store dApp registry, CRFA and Eternl registries.

jpg-store.note: JPG Store v1/v2/v3 ask+bid contracts (StricaHQ, CRFA, Eternl, Yaci Store dApp registry). JPG Store shut down 2026-05-23; its contracts are still served by Wayup afterwards, so activity after 2026-05 belongs to Wayup (see active.until).

liqwid.note: Yaci Store dApp registry. Yaci Store dApp registry (LiqwidFinance) unioned with CRFA and Eternl registries: per-market supply/borrow/batch/oracle-related scripts and governance (Agora-based) scripts.

masumi.note: Payment escrow V1 (bd2adb68) and V2 (a15ce9d8) from PAYMENT_SMART_CONTRACT_ADDRESS(_V2)_MAINNET, agent registry policies V1 (ad6424e3) and V2 (67ab0c92) from REGISTRY_POLICY_ID(_V2)_MAINNET; V1 escrow + registry also in StricaHQ/Eternl registries.

milkomeda.note: Cardano-C1 bridge address, a NATIVE multisig script, per the CRFA registry (also in the Eternl registry). Because it is native it does not appear in transaction_scripts: measure it through the address or payment credential (address_utxo shows about 97k tx, ramping up in 2022-03). Shutdown announced 2025-04-22 by @Milkomeda_com on X (https://x.com/milkomeda_com), with withdrawals required before 2025-09-01 and the service off by 2025-09-05. The Milkomeda metadata label 87 is excluded because it is shared with other protocols.

minswap.note: DEX v2 order/pool/factory/authen(LP)/pool-batching/expired-order-cancel hashes from the official v2 mainnet deployment file; v1 order/pool, stableswap state, LP/factory policies from Yaci Store dApp registry, StricaHQ cardano-contracts-registry and Eternl registry (all three agree, no overlaps with other products). DexHunter-routed swaps also hit these contracts.

newm.note: NEWM marketplace contracts (sale, queue, vault, pointer, batcher cert, band lock-up, data ref, staking) from StricaHQ/Eternl/CRFA, plus 2 stream-token policies from newm-server static/stream-token-policy-ids.json. No activity since 2026-04 (marketplace last used Feb 2026); current stream-token minting policies are in NEWM's DB config and not published, so 0 in Sept may undercount.

nmkr.note: NMKR mainnet minting-costs receiver (key address) hard-coded as Mintingcostsreceiver in NMKR-Studio and special-cased as NMKR's own address in KoiosFunctions.cs (address_info_nmkr). Count = distinct tx creating outputs at this address (address_utxo), ~887k all-time. NMKR mints under per-customer native policies, which are not enumerable.

optim-finance.note: Yaci Store dApp registry. Optim liquidity bonds/loans scripts from Yaci Store dApp registry, CRFA and Eternl registries (these end 2025-2026); plus OADA and sOADA minting policies from OptimFinance/oada-ui src/mainnet/oada-config.ts, which carry the current activity.

orcfax.note: v1 FSP 8793893b... and FS policy/validator 193ee652... (documented deployments page; FSP datum on-chain confirms the FS hash) plus 2023-24 v0 scripts from Yaci Store dApp registry, CRFA and Eternl. Fact-statement publishing on the documented FS stops on 2026-06-18 and no newer deployment is documented, so Sept 2026 = 0.

originatenavio.note: Writes label 1904 (METABUS_TXSUBMITTER_METADATUM_LABEL=1904 in .env.prod; aggregator INDEXER_START_SLOT 109254210 = first 1904 tx, 2023-10-23). Label NOT listed as identifier because 1904 is shared: CIP-10 lists it generically ('proof of origin ... supply chain'), it is also configured in CF's cf-abis-poc and cf-bolnisi-prototype, and since 2026-06 other apps ('atlas' heartbeats, 'clastenium-anchor') write it. Only the 33 tx with body st="georgianWine" (2023-10-23 to 2025-11-14) are Originate; none in Sept 2026.

project-catalyst.note: CIP-15/36 Catalyst voter registration (61284 = registration payload, 61285 = signature witness) plus CIP-509 RBAC registration label 509 used by Catalyst Voices (MetadatumLabel::CIP509_RBAC = 509 in cardano-foundation/catalyst-libs rust/cardano-blockchain-types/src/auxdata/metadatum_label.rs). Caveat: CIP-36 is formally a generic voting-registration format, but in practice Catalyst is the consumer. 509 active 2025-07..2026-03 only. Low Sept 2026 activity is consistent with Funds 15/16 being paused.

pyth.note: Pyth Pro mainnet deployment policy c935c937 (docs), state home script 6d0b0ce6 (address holding the Pyth State NFT) and withdraw/verify script 4949403e (withdraw_script field of the on-chain Pyth State datum, per pyth_state.ak). The withdraw script runs inside consumer dApps' transactions, so these tx overlap with consumers.

realfi.note: Eternl registry RealFi set (orchestrator/mint/stake/management withdraw scripts, order, treasury, staking vault, USDrf/sUSDrf policy, oracles, proxy NFT, native governance multisig). USDrf/sUSDrf policy 7d9e4a0e and staking vault 2efab7b9 are confirmed in docs.realfi.co. Pre-launch setup tx since 2026-06; public mainnet 1 Oct 2026.

reeve.note: Reeve on-chain format uses label 1447 (also registered to Reeve in CIP-10; LOB_METADATA_LABEL default 1447). 1419 of 1429 label-1447 tx (2025-06-30 to 2026-09-04) match the Reeve format. 10 tx from other apps (Mar-Aug 2026 monthly asset reports and governance votes) also use 1447. All 141 Sept-2026 tx are Reeve-format.

rosen-bridge.note: Cardano lock address (key credential ec0b8a9f..., TSS-controlled) and cold-storage address from the contracts-public-launch-7.1.1.json release asset (cardano.addresses.lock/cold; the same values are in rosen-bridge/contract application.conf). There are no Cardano Plutus scripts: the bridge logic is on Ergo. Activity starts 2023-12. sept2026Tx counts distinct txs with outputs to these addresses.

scantrust.note: Live release of the Cardano Foundation/Scantrust metadata connector announced 6 April 2021 (Baia's Wine). No documented label or address. End date unknown.

splash.note: Official Splash mainnet deployment (limit/instant orders, CFMM/fee-switch/balance/stable/royalty pools) incl. the legacy Spectrum Finance pool+order scripts Splash still operates; plus Spectrum swap-order and pool scripts from Yaci Store dApp registry, CRFA, StricaHQ and Eternl registries.

strike-finance.note: V1 perps LP + batcher scripts (May-Sep 2025) and V1/V2 STRIKE staking scripts; hashes taken from the CRFA contractAddress fields (CRFA scriptHash fields for staking are wrong) and matching Eternl entries. Excluded Eternl/CRFA entries labelled "Unknown but associated with Strike". Strike V2 (CLOB, since 2026) settles via a locker/vault address that the docs do not publish, so current perps volume is NOT covered; Sept count is staking only (cardano.org also shows ~23 tx/30d).

sundae-treasury-contracts.note: 8583857e = Intersect 2025 Treasury Reserve Contract (TRC address addr1xxzc8pt7... in the Intersect post; also listed in StricaHQ cardano-contracts-registry intersectbudget.json, CRFA and Eternl). 882cbb37 = Intersect vendor contract (script spent in the post's milestone-withdrawal tx 2c012024..., and listed in the StricaHQ registry). 9beae6fc/a7966878/877f57e0/860ee0f6/e425984e = PRAGMA Amaru 2025 treasury instances (consensus/ledger/mercenaries/marketing/contingency scopes), taken from the leftover-return txs listed at https://hackmd.io/@Amaru/2026BudgetDraft. cf661748 = mainnet test instance linked from the treasury-contracts README. 1694 (CIP-100) metadata is used but is a shared label, so it is excluded. Caveat: the contracts are parameterised per instance, so any newer instances (e.g. 2026 budgets) are not covered.

sundaeswap.note: V1, V3, Stableswaps and V4 (launched 2026-09-17) validators; hash list cross-checked against the official Sundae API protocol blueprints (https://api.sundae.fi/graphql, query protocols{blueprint{validators}}) and scooper-v2 config/mainnet.json; plus V1-era yield-farming scripts from Yaci Store dApp registry and CRFA registry.

surf-lending.note: 37 per-pool cToken minting policies from the official Surf API getAllPoolInfos, plus 18 per-pool position/vault scripts = payment credentials of the position outRefs returned by the official API getAllPositions (one script per pool). Pool-creation and other spends of untracked per-pool scripts are not covered, so this is a lower bound; all hashes first seen Sept 2026.

tapdano.note: metadataLabel 544 was set on TapDano's cardano.org showcase entry by boemekeld (commit b395d17, 2026-03-25), the only contributor to tapdano/applet. Not found in TapDano's public repos. All 1998 label-544 tx (2026-04-13 to 2026-06) have the same shape: an Ed25519 signature split into two parts plus a hashed proof-of-attendance payload (session, student, course, cohort, nonce). That matches TapDano's NFC-signature proof-of-attendance use case. 0 in Sept 2026. TapDano's soulbound NFTs use per-tag policies, and the Aiken validation repo is testnet-only, so no scripts are listed.

trivolve-fms.note: 'FMS Contract' (Plutus V2), 'UP Police Forensics Management Smart Contract by TrivolveTech', from the StricaHQ contracts registry (used by cardano.org tx leaderboard). 147,562 tx 2025-09-15 to 2026-10-19, matching the Oct 2025 mainnet launch (announced 18 Oct 2025, https://techfinancials.co.za/2025/10/18/trivolve-tech-and-quixy-launch-blockchain-powered-fms-on-the-cardano-mainnet/). The separate Indianchain contract 4b0caac5 (Telangana agriculture) is a different Trivolve product and is excluded.

usda.note: USDA minting policy (Plutus, appears in transaction_scripts; token-registry entry name USDA, url anzens.com). Counts only mint/burn tx, not transfers.

usdcx.note: Eternl registry USDCx bridge set: mint policy 1f3aec8b (fingerprint asset1e7eewpjw8ua3f2gpfx7y34ww9vjl63hayn80kl matches IOG/press), bridge processor, operator withdraw-zero, config. Counts bridge mint/burn activity only, not transfers.

usdm.note: USDM minting policy c48cbb3d... (documented by Moneta; Plutus, counted per mint/burn transaction) plus token-counter and two USDM scripts from Yaci Store dApp registry/CRFA/Eternl. Ordinary USDM transfers involve no script, so this measures issuance activity only.

uverify.note: Proxy 07d07e14, State V1 499b5f20, Library 20c3394a (reference-script holder, never executed), and legacy V0 Auth Token a8172157, Issue State 1919c122, Update State 314cdf9e and Connected Goods 2be4b4dc come from the StricaHQ contracts registry. They are cross-checked against uverify-backend: the V0 hashes are hardcoded for MAINNET in ValidatorUtils.java, and the proxy is parameterized with application.yml PROXY_TX_HASH e87045af...#1. A newer state-contract version (c054825a..., Aug 2026+) is deliberately not listed because no published source names it; every one of its transactions also runs the listed proxy, so counts are unaffected. It runs as a withdraw script only in tx that also run the proxy (1842/1842), as 499b5f20 does (11465/11465). Activity: V0 2025-04 to 2025-09, V1 2026-02-18 to 2026-09-30. No proxy or state tx since 2026-09-30 (0 in Oct 1-19).

veridian.note: Cardano backer (KERI witness) constants: METADATUM_LABEL_KEL=13456 (key event log anchoring) and METADATUM_LABEL_SCHEMA=13457. 457 tx under 13456, all KERI10JSON event payloads, 2025-04-03 to 2025-09 (none since). 13457 is unused on mainnet. 0 in Sept 2026, so the optional Cardano trust layer looks dormant on mainnet.

veritree.note: Partnership announced at Cardano Summit (Sept 2021). Cardano Forest reached 1M trees by Jan 2022. No documented policy ID or label found, and current Cardano usage unconfirmed.

vyfinance.note: Yaci Store dApp registry. Yaci Store dApp registry (VyFinance) unioned with StricaHQ, CRFA and Eternl registries: per-pair pool/order validators, vaults and BAR. Contracts are closed source, so no first-party deployment file exists.

wanchain-bridge.note: CRFA and Eternl registries: 'Cross chain bridge' treasury validators 520b2576/1cfb41dc/8d4c43c5 (shared stake credential 259b187a), plus mint 25c5de5f and spend 60ec1132, both unnamed in the registry. 485aa103 = TreasuryCheck validator per the DarkNavy exploit analysis (third party), which also identifies 1cfb41dc as the treasury validator. 520b2576 and 8d4c43c5 have been inactive since 2024-08. TreasuryCheck 485aa103 was last used on the 2026-07-20 exploit date and has likely been replaced by a version that is not documented, so Sept 2026 (15 tx) may undercount.

wayup.note: Wayup own Marketplace and Offer validators (Eternl registry; Marketplace also in StricaHQ registry). Wayup also serves JPG Store contracts after JPG Store closed (2026-05); those hashes are listed under jpg-store and not repeated here.

wingriders.note: DEX v1/v2 request+pool validators and staking scripts from StricaHQ, CRFA, Eternl and Yaci Store dApp registry (agree); Rapid DEX pool 348225d4... from WingRiders/rapid-dex common/src/ref-script-utxos/mainnet.ts.
